findings.note: The studious slots as a restricted-slot grant on classFeatures/studious-spells (which shipped with NO spellSlotBonus at all). Shape copied from the one shipped ladder user, feats/creed-magic (label / note / ladder[{level,byRank,addSpells}] under spellSlotBonus, with entryId naming the class's own entry) — resolveRestrictedSlots (src/rules/restrictedSlots.ts:44-53) makes the ladder REPLACE the rank while addSpells accumulate, which is exactly what print says: 'At 11th level, the extra slots increase to 3rd level and you add haste.' Two slots at every rung, never six. entryId 'magus-casting' is the id buildCharacter stamps on the primary caster (build.ts:3857, `${cls.id}-casting`), so a magus/cleric multiclass cannot take the slots on the wrong entry. Every spell id verified present in the core.json spells bucket: gecko-grip (rank 2), sure-strike (1), water-breathing (2), haste (3), fly (4) — no remaster rename needed; the AoN page class-feature-431 already prints the remastered names ('gecko grip, sure strike, water breathing'). ⚠ The `label` and `entryId` here are a CONTRACT with the eight subclass-option rows below: build.ts (~6790) folds grants that share a label and an entryId into ONE group via mergeRestrictedGrants, which is what keeps the study's spell in the SAME two slots instead of opening an empty second group. Do not change one without the other. The magus slot TABLE is untouched — this authors only the two restricted studious slots print states, nothing about ordinary magus slots (owner question #104).

findings.note: Eight rows, one per magus hybrid study, each hung on the OPTION record inside classes.magus.subclass.options with a `path` step. Path rows addressing an options array by id are the established shape here (58 such rows already, e.g. classes/animist path ['extraChoices','id=apparition','options','id=…']), and they are strictly better than re-emitting the whole options array: the array already has its own effect-backfill row (the grantedFeats one, ~10.8 KB of prose) and a second copy of it would go stale the moment either is edited. ⚠ ORDERING: these rows must sit AFTER that existing `{classes/magus, path:['subclass'], field:'options'}` row in effect-backfill.json (it is at index 13327 of 13342, so appending is enough) — the applier runs rows in file order and a whole-array assignment after them would wipe the nested fields. Each step uses `byRank: {}`, the shape types.ts:1751 specifies for a spells-only rung: 'A step that adds only SPELLS writes byRank: {} … it is folded into the feature's by matching restricted.label, and the empty step picks up the ranks the feature's own step of that level states.' label and entryId therefore match the studious-spells grant exactly. Collector + merge are the ENGINE agent's (build.ts ~6695 `if (subOption?.spellSlotBonus)` and mergeRestrictedGrants, which is referenced but not yet defined in build.ts as I write this). PRINTING CHOSEN — a deliberate divergence from the finding's `printed` field, which lists 'Laughing Shadow 11th: Time Jump': no AoN page prints Time Jump. Two printings exist per study, and I follow the one OUR records ship: hybridStudy/laughing-shadow is aonId hybrid-study-2 edition legacy-era (Secrets of Magic → Blur / Shift Blame / Translocate), and the option's own description text is the Secrets of Magic one (conflux spell Dimensional Assault); the Impossible Magic reprint hybrid-study-11 prints Ghostly Weapon instead. Same rule for starlit-span (hybrid-study-4, Darkvision — the reprint says Telekinetic Maneuver) and twisting-tree (hybrid-study-5, Embed Message — the reprint says Oaken Resilience); aloof-firmament, unfurling-brocade and resurgent-maelstrom have one printing each. All 24 spell ids exist in the core.json spells bucket, shift-blame included. All EIGHT studies are authored (the task named five; the proposal and the AoN pages list eight and every id resolves, so leaving three studies short would be a known gap).

findings.note: NO ROWS OF ITS OWN — the data is the ladder authored under studious-spells#gecko-grip and the eight option rows. 'You add any spells from this class feature to your spellbook' is a READER change: the magus falls into the generic prepared branch at src/rules/build.ts:3931 (the grantedByRank spellbook merge is gated `cls.id === 'wizard' || cls.id === 'witch'`), and build.ts:9021-9025 actively filters the studious ids back OUT of b.spells on recovery. The ENGINE agent sources the ids from classFeatures/studious-spells.spellSlotBonus.restricted.ladder[].addSpells (plus the chosen option's) — which is why they are authored as data rather than left in spellcasting.ts. The magus slot table is untouched (owner question #104).
